text:
Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
Rating power: 400 kw.a
Ampere: 47A..a
R.P.M: 1490.a
The first draft initiated by eng. El-Said Mohamed Matareed, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued.
Safety fences with caution marks surrounding the work area must be used.
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes earplug, and gloves pairs.
The motor must be out 
 of service.
Circuit breaker in test 
 position.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set, Air blower.
Greasing machine.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Brushes, (soft brushes).
Work to be Carried Out
Ensure that all fixing bolts are 
secured.
Ensure that electrical connection are 
tightened.
Check the isolators and clean them.
Check all protection devices of the 
motor by protection group.
